en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force with northerly gusts to 72 km/h
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the signal continues, with Cheung Chau recording 52 km/h sustained winds and 72 km/h gusts in the hour to 7.30am.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force on Tuesday morning, with strong northerly winds expected and mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour.

In the past hour ending 7.30am, the maximum sustained winds recorded at Cheung Chau were 52 kilometres per hour, with a maximum gust of 72 kilometres per hour, the Observatory said. Gusts may occasionally reach gale force.

The Observatory advised people not well sheltered from the north to take precautions against strong gusty winds, and to bring flower pots and loose objects indoors. Small craft owners should secure their boats, and the public should stay away from the shoreline and avoid water sports because of rough seas, especially offshore.
The Red Fire Danger Warning, indicating extreme fire risk, also remains in force after being issued on Monday morning.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號持續 長洲陣風達每小時72公里
zh.dek: 天文台表示信號仍然生效，今早七時半前一小時長洲錄得持續風速52公里、陣風72公里。
body: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號周二早上仍然生效，預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里。
天文台指出，在上午七時半的過去一小時，長洲錄得的最高持續風速為每小時52公里，最高陣風為每小時72公里。陣風間中可達烈風程度。
天文台提醒，如果身在當風地方，會受到偏北風正面吹襲，應採取預防措施，以防強勁陣風帶來損害，花盆及可能被風吹倒的物件應搬入室內。小艇艇戶應確保小艇安全，並檢查甲板上的物件是否綁緊。由於海面可能有大浪，市民應遠離岸邊及停止所有水上活動，離岸海域風浪尤其大。
紅色火災危險警告亦仍然生效，表示火災危險性極高。該警告於周一早上發出。
